gloss: commentary (audio/video commentary track; running explanation of an event)

definitions.explanation: A running spoken explanation accompanying an event, broadcast, film, or game. コメンタリー most often refers to sports/event play-by-play, audio commentary tracks on DVDs and streaming releases, or behind-the-scenes commentary by directors and creators. As a loanword it has a slightly modern, media-industry feel and is more common than {解説|かいせつ} in entertainment contexts.

examples.japanese: コメンタリー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧コメンタリー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I listened to the director's commentary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧コメンタリー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦アナウンサー→アナウンサー：01765_anaunsaa⟧。
examples.english: The announcer in charge of the match commentary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{特別版|とくべつばん}→特別版：24333_tokubetsuban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ブルーレイ→ブルーレイ：27074_buruurei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{脚本家|きゃくほんか}→脚本家：13962_kyakuhonka⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧コメンタリー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{収録|しゅうろく}→収録：08378_shuuroku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The special edition Blu-ray includes commentary by the director and screenwriter.

notes:
コメンタリー is the English loanword "commentary," used most often in entertainment and media contexts.

USAGE:
- Audio/video commentary tracks bundled with films, anime, and games
- Live or recorded sports commentary (play-by-play with analysis)
- Behind-the-scenes creator commentary in interviews and bonus features
- For DVDs and Blu-rays, the standard menu label is コメンタリー or ⟦{音声|おんせい}→音声：04445_onsei⟧コメンタリー rather than ⟦{解説|かいせつ}→解説：00138_kaisetsu⟧.
- In sports broadcasting, the speaker is often called the ⟦{解説者|かいせつしゃ}→解説者：09688_kaisetsusha⟧ (color commentator) even when their work as a whole is referred to as コメンタリー.
- Written political or social commentary (e.g., op-eds) is much more often called ⟦{論評|ろんぴょう}→論評：18443_ronpyou⟧ or ⟦{解説|かいせつ}→解説：00138_kaisetsu⟧, not コメンタリー.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{音声|おんせい}→音声：04445_onsei⟧コメンタリー: audio commentary (track)
- ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧コメンタリー: director's commentary
- コメンタリー⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with commentary (included)
- ⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧コメンタリー: live commentary
- ⟦{実況|じっきょう}→実況：12281_jikkyou⟧コメンタリー: live play-by-play commentary

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{解説|かいせつ}→解説：00138_kaisetsu⟧: commentary, explanation — more general; used for news analysis, exam answer keys, museum exhibits, and so on. ⟦{解説|かいせつ}→解説：00138_kaisetsu⟧ is the everyday word; コメンタリー is more specifically the bonus-track / sports-broadcast sense.
- ⟦{実況|じっきょう}→実況：12281_jikkyou⟧: live broadcast / play-by-play (the moment-to-moment narration of an event in progress)
- ⟦ナレーション→ナレーション：24412_nareeshon⟧: narration (a scripted voice-over, typically not interactive)
